name: Chubby Bumblebee
description: Hand-sculpted sweet honey bee with bright yellow glaze, black stripes, blushing pink cheeks, and white wings. Sturdy swivel clasp keychain or magnet.

name: Blueberry Pancake Stack
description: Triple stack of golden syrup-glazed pancakes topped with melted butter and fresh blueberries. Perfect miniature brunch accessory.

name: Croissant & Chocolate Bar
description: Golden flaky Parisian croissant charm paired with a glossy dark chocolate bar charm on a sturdy silver chain.

name: Strawberry Cream Macaron
description: Pastel pink French macaron with ruffled feet and vanilla buttercream filling, paired with a dangling pastel pearl charm.

name: Sweet Ghostie Spook
description: Cheerfully sculpted white ghost Weeble with tiny arms open for hugs. Perfect miniature companion as a refrigerator magnet or keychain.

name: Pumpkin Spice Latte Mug
description: Carved miniature bright orange pumpkin mug topped with a generous swirl of fluffy whipped cream and high-gloss protective glaze.

name: Strawberry Bunny
description: Hand-sculpted baby bunny wearing a fresh strawberry beret. Coated in glossy, UV-cured protective glaze.

name: Matcha Boba Froggy
description: Round chubby frog resting atop a miniature matcha boba cup with tapioca pearls. Ultra cute refrigerator companion.

name: Sweet Lavender Spook
description: Gentle friendly pastel ghost holding a blooming lavender flower. Glows softly in the dark under UV light.
